not_screened.selection_budget_bits: spent only by a locked plan's contingencies (R20); no attack or workload here declares one, so its effect would be zero by construction
not_screened.cross_person_audit: a mode, not a number, and with one person per evaluation there is nobody else's release to combine with
not_screened.response_quantum_ms: the timing channel, measured on the wall clock (D5)
not_screened.response_ceiling_ms: the timing channel, measured on the wall clock (D5)
not_screened.vetter: a choice of rule set, measured on its own (artifacts/composite_cost.json)
not_screened.checker_cmd: configures the external vetter named by `vetter`
not_screened.differencing_delta: its floor sets it to `min_cell_size` (hardening #127), so it moves with the cell floor; the screen with it apart, and the rank audit at either, is artifacts/policy_sensitivity_audit_at_floor.json
